name: token-profiler
description: Local observability tool for LLM/AI Agent token traffic. Collects and reports byte-basis context metrics (UCV/CTV/amplification/reuse) and raw-data exports; the UI adds a heuristic diagnostic reading (reference zones, duplicate-context ranking) but not cause assertions, synthetic scores, or optimization.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:ui
